0022600023.text: The Warriors, now 2-3 and 10th in the West after a two-game winning streak, host the 4-1 Lakers in their sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with Golden State 2nd in the Pacific, 2 games back of Los Angeles, which sits 1st in the division. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (out, knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee, surgery), while Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision. The Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (out, oblique strain), and Ziaire Williams is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision.
